description: Find CBS locality codes by name in Hebrew, Russian, English or Arabic. Use the code with get_locality.

limit.description: Maximum matching records per page, 1–50; default 10.

offset.description: Number of matching records to skip for pagination, 0–10000; default 0.

query.description: Locality name or CBS code to search for, 1–100 characters. Hebrew, Russian, English and Arabic names are supported.

name: search_localities
